name: -6 AN Fitting 90 Degree Male to Male Flare Union
description:
ColorFittings 90 Degree Male to Male Union Adapters are precision CNC-machined to provide a compact 90-degree connection between female AN fittings, improving hose routing and clearance in tight engine bays. Designed with true 37-degree AN flare seats on both ends, these adapters deliver a secure, leak-free seal for fuel, oil, coolant, transmission, brake, and power steering systems.
Manufactured from aerospace-grade 6061-T6 billet aluminum and finished with ColorFittings' proprietary polishing and anodizing process, these adapters offer exceptional strength, corrosion resistance, and long-term durability. Built for high-pressure and high-temperature environments, they are compatible with E85, ethanol-based fuels, race fuel, pump gas, diesel, oil, coolant, transmission fluid, hydraulic fluid, and air systems.
Ideal for street performance, racing, off-road, marine, and custom fabrication projects, these 90-degree male unions make it easy to reroute fluid lines while maintaining maximum flow and reliable sealing.
Looking to complete your system? Explore our full range of AN fittings, adapters, braided hose, and fitting assembly tools.
